title: Medical Document AI Assistant & Explainer
description: Build an enterprise-grade medical documentation QA platform that ingests clinical PDFs, chunks text using semantic splitters, indexes embeddings in ChromaDB, and uses LangChain + RAG to answer clinical queries with page-level citations.
key_deliverables: PDF chunking & embedding pipeline with BAAI/bge embeddings
FastAPI REST endpoint for hybrid search and context retrieval
Streamlit UI with source page highlighting and citation viewer
Evaluation script calculating faithfulness & context precision

├── backend/
│   ├── main.py
│   ├── rag_engine.py
│   └── vector_store.py
├── frontend/
│   └── app.py
├── data/
└── tests/
    └── test_rag.py

title: AI Candidate Screening & Skill Gap Predictor
description: Develop an automated candidate resume screener that extracts candidate skills using NLP, predicts job fit using a trained Scikit-Learn Random Forest model, and provides transparent feature importance breakdowns for recruiter decision support.
key_deliverables: Feature engineering pipeline mapping resume text to skill vectors
Scikit-Learn classifier predicting candidate match likelihood
FastAPI endpoint returning JSON fit scores and missing skill alerts

├── model/
│   ├── train.py
│   └── predictor.py
├── api/
│   └── main.py
└── dashboard/
    └── app.py

title: Autonomous Code Security & Architecture Review Agent
description: Build an autonomous AI agent that accepts GitHub repository URLs, containerizes analysis in Docker, inspects Python/JS source code for security vulnerabilities (OWASP top 10), and produces automated pull-request code reviews.
key_deliverables: Dockerized sandbox environment for static code analysis
Multi-step LangChain agent workflow with feedback reflection
Custom system prompts for AST parsing & vulnerability detection
Automated markdown report generator with code fix diffs
repo_structure:
code-auditor-agent/
├── agent/
│   ├── evaluator.py
│   └── prompts.py
├── sandbox/
│   └── Dockerfile
└── app.py

title: Scalable Microservices Gateway & Rate-Limiting Engine
description: Design and deploy an asynchronous FastAPI API gateway featuring token bucket rate limiting via Redis, JWT user authentication middleware, dynamic service discovery, and Prometheus metric tracking.
key_deliverables: Async FastAPI gateway handling reverse proxy routes
Redis sliding-window rate limiter preventing API abuse
JWT authentication middleware with role-based access control
Docker Compose stack orchestrating services & Redis
